_comment: App registry. Env vars and secrets are deliberately NOT listed here — gcpdeploy reads the live Cloud Run service and swaps only the image, so this file can never drift out of sync with production.

beer.unsupported: Hopscotch builds through its own cloudbuild.yaml with a git-sha image tag, an APP_VERSION build arg, and a separate 'hopscotch' Artifact Registry repo. Its committed deploy tooling also assumes gcloud, which does not exist here, and names two secrets that do not exist in this project (hopscotch-anthropic-key, hopscotch-cron-secret) — the live service uses the shared anthropic-api-key and cron-secret. Deploy it by hand until that is reconciled.
